name: BoardWise
description: BoardWise is a read-only educational MCP server for licensed professionals — nurses, physicians, pharmacists, social workers, CDL holders, and others — facing state licensing-board matters. Claude can use it to look up jurisdiction-specific response deadlines, generate structured outlines for response letters, search BoardWise's library of educational guides, and surface curated resources for situations like complaints, CEU audits, consent agreements, hearing notices, and self-reports. All responses are general educational information (not legal advice). No personal or case data is transmitted, stored, or sent to third parties.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BoardWise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BoardWise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://uakozrqrztgrgwoywxkx.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Is BoardWise MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, BoardWise scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BoardWise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BoardWise provides these MCP tools: get_board_guidance, get_response_letter_guidance, find_relevant_guide, and get_resources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BoardWise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BoardWise in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, PomoDial, and Soracom Knowledge.
BoardWise does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
BoardWise is developed by BoardWise. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
